definitions.explanation: An exclamation of frustration, anger, or annoyance. Originally from 畜生 (beast/brute), a Buddhist term for animals as one of the lower realms of existence. Now used as a mild to moderate swear word.

examples.japanese: ちくしょう、⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧⟦{負|ま}けた→負ける：01134_makeru⟧！
ちくしょう、⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
ちくしょう、⟦あいつ→あいつ：08267_aitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{先|さき}を{越|こ}される→先を越される：21646_sakiwokosareru⟧⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧⟦{悔|くや}しい→悔しい：02343_kuyashii⟧。
examples.english: Damn it, it's so frustrating to be beaten to it by that guy.

notes:
Originally written as {畜生|ちくしょう} (beast), a Buddhist term for the animal realm, one of the six paths of reincarnation. Calling someone a {畜生|ちくしょう} was a strong insult ("you beast"). Now it is mainly used as a standalone exclamation of frustration, roughly equivalent to "damn!" in English.

Stronger than ⟦くそ→くそ：10783_kuso⟧ in some speakers' usage, but generally considered a mild swear word. More commonly used by men. Shortened forms include ちく⟦しょー→ショー：10950_shoo⟧ and ちっく⟦しょー→ショー：10950_shoo⟧.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦くそ→くそ：10783_kuso⟧ — damn, crap
- しまった — oh no, I messed up
- {畜生|ちくしょう} — beast (kanji form / original meaning)
